correctness.rationale: The correct state reduction follows from the actual Algorithm 2: initial x=z=e1 on diagonal Hessian means only first coordinate can move; with theta=t/d the two 2x2 conditional updates K0 and K1 in RESULT.md follow directly. Their exact second-moment action S(K) on (E[a²],E[ab],E[b²]) gives M_d(t)=((d-1)S(K0)+S(K1))/d, w0=(1,1,1), and E f_kappa(x_j)=kappa(M^j w0)_1/2. I independently differentiated these rational matrices symbolically for d=2,3,5 and verified coefficient-by-coefficient N1 and N2 as printed, including the lower-left coefficient (d-1)/d². The Jordan chain 1->2->3->1 has leading product 2(d-1)t^4/d^4, forcing the three distinct Puiseux roots with shifts C_d*zeta*t^(4/3); the real root has strictly largest modulus for small positive t. The displayed positive left/right eigenvector leading components and h.v->3 exclude cancellation by w0/e1, so the fixed-kappa successive expected-objective ratio tends to that dominant root. Numerical eigensolutions for d=2,3,5, t=0.001 agreed with 1-2t/d+C_dt^(4/3). Fixed d and asymptotic k->infinity preceding kappa->0 are essential; finite checks alone would not prove either asymptotic.
